name: Enosh
title: The one who called on the name of the Lord
summary: Enosh was the son of Seth and the grandson of Adam. He is known as the one in whose time people began to call on the name of the Lord, marking the beginning of organized worship of God. According to the Bible, he lived 905 years.

keyEvents.title: The birth of Enosh
keyEvents.description: Enosh was born as the son of Seth when Seth was 105 years old. He became part of the godly lineage from Adam through Seth.

keyEvents.title: The Calling on the Name of the Lord Begins
keyEvents.description: In Enosh's time, people began to call on the name of the Lord. This marks an important turning point in humanity's spiritual history and the beginning of formal worship.

keyEvents.title: Enosh Becomes the Father of Kenan
keyEvents.description: When Enosh was 90 years old, he had a son named Kenan, who continued the godly lineage toward Noah.

keyEvents.title: The Life and Descendants of Enosh
keyEvents.description: After Kenan was born, Enosh lived for another 815 years and had more sons and daughters. His total lifespan was 905 years.

keyEvents.title: Enosh in Jesus' Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Enosh is mentioned in Luke's genealogy as part of the lineage from Adam to Jesus Christ, highlighting his place in salvation history.

keyEvents.title: Enosh in First Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Enosh is listed in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles as a link in the line from Adam through Seth, confirming his place in the biblical genealogy.
